goal_text:
Fix the following problems in boltons, as described by contributors. Add or update tests for each fix.

### Render wrapped causes when no traceback was captured (boltons#562)

`ExceptionCauseMixin` captures a traceback only while handling its wrapped cause. Wrapping a stored exception outside that handler (or while handling an unrelated error) leaves `full_trace` unset, causing `str(error)` and `get_str()` to raise `AttributeError`. Treat the absent trace as empty and retain the existing cause/message formatting.

Validation: 3 new rendering regressions fail on master and pass with the fix, covering direct wrapping, chained wrapping, and an unrelated active exception. Full suite: 681 tests and 12 subtests pass.

The full test suite (python -m pytest -q --doctest-modules boltons tests) must stay green.
planner_notes: One indivisible task: fix in boltons/excutils.py plus new tests/test_excutils.py (no existing tests reference ExceptionCauseMixin). No overlapping scopes. Risk: __new__ copies full_trace/_tb/_stack from a cause only when cause.full_trace is not None; keep that, use a class default/getattr only.

tasks.description: In boltons/excutils.py, make ExceptionCauseMixin render when no traceback was captured. Currently full_trace is only set inside __new__ when the cause is the exception being handled, so _get_trace_str() raises AttributeError on self.full_trace for causes wrapped outside a handler or during an unrelated exception. Fix: treat a missing full_trace as empty (e.g. add class attribute `full_trace = None` next to `cause = None`, and/or use getattr(self, 'full_trace', None) in _get_trace_str). Keep existing cause/message formatting. Add new file tests/test_excutils.py with 3 regression tests, using `class MyErr(ExceptionCauseMixin): pass`: (1) direct wrapping: `w = MyErr(ValueError('boom'), 'msg')` outside any handler; str(w) and w.get_str() don't raise, contain 'msg' and 'caused by', and don't contain 'Traceback'. (2) chained wrapping: wrap w in another MyErr outside a handler; str/get_str work and mention the root cause. (3) wrap a stored exception while an unrelated exception is handled (`try: raise KeyError('x')` / `except KeyError: w = MyErr(stored)`); str/get_str work without traceback text.
tasks.spec_ref: ExceptionCauseMixin(cause_exc, *args) in boltons/excutils.py. New behavior: if no traceback was captured (full_trace never set), _get_trace_str() returns '' so __str__ returns self._get_exc_str(incl_name=False) and get_str() returns only the exc string (class name + ': ' + message + ' (caused by ...)', or ' caused by ...' when no message). No AttributeError. Unchanged: when a cause is wrapped while it is the exception being handled, full_trace is set and str() contains 'Wrapped traceback (most recent call last):'; with no cause, str(e) is the plain Exception str.

claim_probes.name: full_trace_set_when_handling_cause
no_cause_plain_str
claim_probes.code:
from boltons.excutils import ExceptionCauseMixin

class E(ExceptionCauseMixin):
    pass

def test_it():
    e = E('plain')
    assert e.cause is None
    assert str(e) == 'plain'
